:::{#thm-standardization}
#### Identification by standardization

Suppose $\vec{L}$ is discrete,
and that [consistency](#def-consistency),
conditional [exchangeability](#def-exchangeability) given $\vec{L}$,
and [positivity](#def-positivity) hold.
Then for each treatment level $a \in \cb{0, 1}$,

$$
\E{Y(a)} = \sum_{\vec{l}} \E{Y \mid A = a, \vec{L} = \vec{l}} \Pf{\vec{L} = \vec{l}}
$$ {#eq-standardization}

where the sum runs over the support of $\vec{L}$.

:::

::: proof
For treatment level $a$:

$$
\ba
\E{Y(a)}
&= \sum_{\vec{l}} \E{Y(a) \mid \vec{L} = \vec{l}} \Pf{\vec{L} = \vec{l}}
&& \text{(law of total expectation over } \vec{L} \text{)} \\
&= \sum_{\vec{l}} \E{Y(a) \mid A = a, \vec{L} = \vec{l}} \Pf{\vec{L} = \vec{l}}
&& \text{(conditional exchangeability: } Y(a) \ind A \mid \vec{L} \text{)} \\
&= \sum_{\vec{l}} \E{Y \mid A = a, \vec{L} = \vec{l}} \Pf{\vec{L} = \vec{l}}
&& \text{(consistency: } Y = Y(a) \text{ when } A = a \text{)}
\ea
$$

Positivity guarantees $\Pf{A = a \mid \vec{L} = \vec{l}} > 0$
for every $\vec{l}$ in the support,
so each conditioning event $\cb{A = a, \vec{L} = \vec{l}}$ has positive probability
and every term in the second and third lines is defined.
:::
